blocks.prompt: 6 (a) A circle has the parametric equations: \(x = 3 + 5\cos\theta\), \(y = -1 + 5\sin\theta\). Find the Cartesian equation of the circle.
blocks.explanation:
Parametric equations mein \(x\) aur \(y\) dono ek teesre variable \(\theta\) (parameter) par depend karte hain. Cartesian equation ka matlab: \(\theta\) ko khatam kar ke sirf \(x\), \(y\) ka rishta.
Diya kya hai? \(x = 3 + 5\cos\theta\), \(y = -1 + 5\sin\theta\).
Find kya karna hai? Cartesian equation.
Rule kaunsa? \(\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta = 1\) (Example 2 wali chaal).
Plan: \(\cos\theta\) aur \(\sin\theta\) wale terms akele karo, square kar ke jama karo.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x = 3 + 5\cos\theta\), \(y = -1 + 5\sin\theta\).
Maloom karna: Cartesian equation.
Tareeqa: \(\theta\) ko identity \(\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta = 1\) se khatam karenge.

Trig terms akele karein
\[x - 3 = 5\cos\theta,\quad y + 1 = 5\sin\theta\]
Kyun: 3 ko left par aur \(-1\) ko left par le gaye, taake har taraf sirf ek trig term rahe.

Square kar ke jama karein
\[(x - 3)^2 + (y + 1)^2 = 25\cos^2\theta + 25\sin^2\theta\]
\[= 25(\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta) = 25\]
Kyun: Square karne se \(\cos^2\theta\) aur \(\sin^2\theta\) bante hain, jin ka jama 1 hai; \(\theta\) gayab.
Dhyan dein: Pehle akela kiye baghair square karna (jaise \(x^2 = (3 + 5\cos\theta)^2\)) kaam ulajh deta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\theta = 0:\ (8, -1),\quad 25 + 0 = 25 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\theta = 0\) par parametric se \((8, -1)\) mila, aur woh Cartesian equation ko satisfy karta hai.

blocks.prompt: 6 (b) A circle has the parametric equations: \(x = 3 + 5\cos\theta\), \(y = -1 + 5\sin\theta\). Find the centre and radius of the circle.
blocks.explanation:
Part (a) mein standard form mil gaya hai, us se centre aur radius seedha parhne hain.
Diya kya hai? \((x - 3)^2 + (y + 1)^2 = 25\).
Find kya karna hai? Centre aur radius.
Rule kaunsa? Theorem 1 se muqabla.
Plan: \(h\), \(k\), \(r\) parho, aur general form se tasdeeq karo.
steps:
Diya gaya: part (a) se \((x - 3)^2 + (y + 1)^2 = 25\).
Maloom karna: centre aur radius.
Tareeqa: \((x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2\) se milana.

Muqabla karein
\[(x - 3)^2 + (y - (-1))^2 = 5^2\]
\[h = 3,\ k = -1,\ r = 5\]
Kyun: \(y + 1\) ko \(y - (-1)\) likha to \(k = -1\) saaf nazar aaya.
Dhyan dein: Parametric equations mein bhi yahi numbers chhupe the: \(x = 3 + 5\cos\theta\) mein 3 centre ka \(x\), \(-1\) centre ka \(y\), aur 5 radius.

Tasdeeq
\[g = -3,\ f = 1,\ c = -15\]
\[r = \sqrt{9 + 1 + 15} = 5 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: General form se bhi centre \((-g, -f) = (3, -1)\) aur radius 5. Aam qaida: \(x = h + r\cos\theta\), \(y = k + r\sin\theta\) woh circle hai jis ka centre \((h, k)\) aur radius \(r\) hai.

blocks.prompt: 6 (c) A circle has the parametric equations: \(x = 3 + 5\cos\theta\), \(y = -1 + 5\sin\theta\). Find the parametric coordinates of the point \(P\) on the circle corresponding to \(\theta = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
blocks.explanation:
Parameter \(\theta\) ki har value circle ka ek point deti hai.
Diya kya hai? Parametric equations aur \(\theta = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
Find kya karna hai? Point \(P\) ke coordinates.
Rule kaunsa? Seedha substitution.
Plan: \(\theta = \frac{\pi}{2}\) dono equations mein rakho.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x = 3 + 5\cos\theta\), \(y = -1 + 5\sin\theta\); \(\theta = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
Maloom karna: point \(P\).
Tareeqa: \(\theta\) ki value rakhni hai.

Value rakhein
\[x = 3 + 5\cos\tfrac{\pi}{2} = 3 + 0 = 3\]
\[y = -1 + 5\sin\tfrac{\pi}{2} = -1 + 5 = 4\]
Kyun: \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) yani \(90^\circ\): \(\cos 90^\circ = 0\), \(\sin 90^\circ = 1\).
Dhyan dein: Calculator degree mode mein ho aur aap \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ko 1.57 degree samjhein to ghalat jawab aayega; yeh radians hain.

Tasdeeq
\[(3 - 3)^2 + (4 + 1)^2 = 25 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(P\) circle par hai. Yeh circle ka sab se ooncha point hai, centre \((3, -1)\) se seedha 5 units upar; ghari ki sui ki tarah \(\theta = 90^\circ\) seedha upar ki taraf ishara karta hai.

blocks.prompt: 6 (d) A circle has the parametric equations: \(x = 3 + 5\cos\theta\), \(y = -1 + 5\sin\theta\). Find the equation of the tangent to the circle at point \(P\).
blocks.explanation:
\(P(3, 4)\) general circle par hai, is liye 6.2.2 ka substitution rule lagega.
Diya kya hai? Circle \(x^2 + y^2 - 6x + 2y - 15 = 0\) aur \(P(3, 4)\).
Find kya karna hai? \(P\) par tangent.
Rule kaunsa? \(xx_1 + yy_1 + g(x + x_1) + f(y + y_1) + c = 0\).
Plan: \(g, f, c\) aur \((x_1, y_1)\) rakh kar simplify.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x^2 + y^2 - 6x + 2y - 15 = 0\), yani \(g = -3\), \(f = 1\), \(c = -15\); \(P(3, 4)\).
Maloom karna: \(P\) par tangent.
Tareeqa: \(xx_1 + yy_1 + g(x + x_1) + f(y + y_1) + c = 0\).

Values rakhein
\[3x + 4y - 3(x + 3) + (y + 4) - 15 = 0\]
\[3x + 4y - 3x - 9 + y + 4 - 15 = 0\]
\[5y - 20 = 0\]
\[y = 4\]
Kyun: \(3x\) aur \(-3x\) cancel ho gaye, sirf \(y\) bacha: horizontal line.
Dhyan dein: \(x\) terms ka gayab hona ghalti nahi; ooncha ya neecha point ho to tangent horizontal hi hota hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{distance from } (3, -1) \text{ to } y = 4 = 5 = r \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(P\) circle ka sab se ooncha point hai; wahan tangent zameen ke mutawazi (horizontal) hona chahiye, jaise gend ke upar rakhi seedhi chhari. Centre \((3, -1)\) se line \(y = 4\) ka faasla \(4 - (-1) = 5\) hai, jo radius ke barabar hai.

blocks.prompt: 6 (e) A circle has the parametric equations: \(x = 3 + 5\cos\theta\), \(y = -1 + 5\sin\theta\). Find the equation of the normal to the circle at point \(P\).
blocks.explanation:
Normal woh line hai jo point par tangent ke perpendicular ho; circle mein yeh hamesha centre se guzarti hai.
Diya kya hai? \(P(3, 4)\) par tangent \(y = 4\), centre \((3, -1)\).
Find kya karna hai? \(P\) par normal.
Rule kaunsa? Horizontal ka perpendicular vertical.
Plan: \(P\) se vertical line.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(P(3, 4)\) par tangent \(y = 4\); centre \((3, -1)\).
Maloom karna: \(P\) par normal.
Tareeqa: Normal tangent par perpendicular hai aur centre se guzarta hai.

\(P\) se vertical line
\[x = 3\]
Kyun: Horizontal line ka slope 0 hai; is ke perpendicular line vertical hoti hai (slope define nahi), jis ki equation \(x = \text{constant}\). \(P\) ka \(x\) 3 hai.
Dhyan dein: Yahan slope formula \(-\frac{1}{m}\) nahi chalega kyunke \(m = 0\); seedha geometry se sochiye.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{centre } (3, -1):\ x = 3 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Normal centre se guzarta hai, aur centre ka \(x\) bhi 3 hai. Yeh line darasal \(P\) aur centre ko milane wala radius hi hai.

blocks.prompt: 6 (f) A circle has the parametric equations: \(x = 3 + 5\cos\theta\), \(y = -1 + 5\sin\theta\). Find the equation of the tangent to the circle at the point where \(\theta = \pi\).
blocks.explanation:
Pehle \(\theta = \pi\) wala point nikalna hai, phir us par tangent.
Diya kya hai? Parametric equations aur \(\theta = \pi\).
Find kya karna hai? Us point par tangent.
Rule kaunsa? Substitution, phir 6.2.2 ka tangent rule.
Plan: point nikalo, \(g = -3\), \(f = 1\), \(c = -15\) ke saath rule lagao.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x = 3 + 5\cos\theta\), \(y = -1 + 5\sin\theta\); \(\theta = \pi\).
Maloom karna: us point par tangent.
Tareeqa: Point nikal kar \(xx_1 + yy_1 + g(x + x_1) + f(y + y_1) + c = 0\), jahan \(g = -3\), \(f = 1\), \(c = -15\).

\((-2, -1)\) par tangent
\[-2x - y - 3(x - 2) + (y - 1) - 15 = 0\]
\[-2x - y - 3x + 6 + y - 1 - 15 = 0\]
\[-5x - 10 = 0\]
\[x = -2\]
Kyun: \(x_1 = -2\), \(y_1 = -1\): \(x + x_1 = x - 2\), \(y + y_1 = y - 1\). \(-y\) aur \(+y\) cancel, vertical line bachi.
Dhyan dein: \(-3(x - 2) = -3x + 6\); minus ko bracket ke andar dono terms par lagana hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\text{distance from } (3, -1) \text{ to } x = -2 = 5 = r \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \((-2, -1)\) circle ka sab se baayan (leftmost) point hai, centre ki seedh mein 5 units left; wahan tangent vertical hona hi chahiye.
